expires_today.title: Backrooms and Liminal World Builder Bundle

expires_today.title: Legend In The Mist & :Otherscape RPG Collection by Son of Oak
expires_today.description: High fantasies, tech dystopias, and beyond

expires_today.title: The Original Worlds of Timothy Zahn by Open Road Media
expires_today.long_description: Looking for a new science fiction author to stack your library? Or perhaps you’re already a big fan and you want to fill in some gaps? Either way, this bundle of Timothy Zahn’s best sci-fi novels is an essential collection to add to your digital bookshelves! Find the truth inside a black hole and save the empires of humanity in Angelmass! Fight back against alien overlords with the enhanced mercenaries of The Blackcollar! Follow a young con artist and his draconic companion as they uncover a dangerous intergalactic conspiracy in Dragon and Thief! There’s even more to explore in this bundle of adventures from the author of Star Wars’ Thrawn saga, so grab them now at the price of your choice and support the Comic Book Legal Defense Fund with your purchase!

expires_tomorrow.title: Kurt Busiek's Astro City: The 30th Anniversary by Image Comics
expires_tomorrow.long_description: Celebrate multi‑time Eisner and Harvey Award winner author Kurt Busiek’s most popular works with The 30th Anniversary Bundle by Image Comics! How do average people, support teams, and even villains navigate day‑to‑day life in a world where being truly super is possible—read volumes 1‑17 and see what makes Astro City so unforgettable. Pay what you want for critically acclaimed comics and help support The BINC Foundation with your purchase!
